record.excerpt: Target Stocks: All components of the Nikkei 225 … Only daily charts are used. … Period: Fixed at 80 days … Upper and lower bands: Fixed at ±1σ … Setup: Price crosses above the +1σ line from below … Buy at the next day’s open using a market order … If the price crosses below the middle band, sell at the next day’s open using a market order … Test Period: January 4, 2000 – December 30, 2024 … Win Rate: 33.45%
record.notes: Bollinger 80/1σ breakout on Japanese equities; mechanical but out of asset universe.

spec.claim_summary: A daily strategy on Nikkei 225 components that buys when price crosses above the 80-day +1σ Bollinger upper band and sells when price crosses below the 80-day middle band.
assumptions: Middle band interpreted as the standard Bollinger middle band, an 80-period simple moving average.
Bollinger settings mapped as period 80 with std width 1.0 from 'Period: Fixed at 80 days' and 'Upper and lower bands: Fixed at ±1σ'.
Rules evaluated on daily bar closes with fills at the next bar's open, matching the claim's next-day open market-order execution.
Direction inferred as long from buy-then-sell wording.
No stop-loss, take-profit or time exit stated; exit is only the middle-band cross.

NOT EXPRESSIBLE: Claim requires trading all components of the Nikkei 225 individually as a constituent basket; the spec can only hold a single NIKKEI225 ticker placeholder, so testing the index is not equivalent to testing the constituent basket.
